I've really enjoyed playing this game. I received the game for free to review : you can see that here ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E_vP5ZSdOCk ) but i'm continuing to play through it even after finishing that. Have only come across one bug and now at the point where i need more content to keep playing as we're getting through the 2 currently available levels pretty quickly. Love the design and customisation options so far.

A quick review is the music is [b]BOPPIN[/b], Fun gameplay, difficulty and progression. 

My only 2 negatives about this game which can be fixed over time; is the story is not done yet, and the levels feel kind of cramped. Like I want to see those grind-rails used more and over longer distances. Other then that super fun and bet its better in coop.
Edit: Yes its better in coop but the waiting for brobot stuff disrupts flow and should only be there to start the level, end the level/start a boss

It's like Doom and Borderlands mixed together minus the demons replaced with robots. FPS rogue-lites are usually not common, but if I had to say if this one is worth the wait. It is and with the random map layout each run, weapons, and cores inside the game. You will enjoy going through it more times over and over to get better each run. Double jumping and grinding on rails to take down enemies of a large assortment of types. You have three classes in the game Guardian (Which you start as) that uses rockets and punches enemies, Recon that can mark enemies to deal extra damage to them and uses a knife instead of punching, and last but not least Engineer that uses drones to fight by your side and a taser to shock and attempt to stun enemies.

Weapons come in tons of variety from bullet type games to lasers and explosives. You got types like Assault, Precision, Explosives, Technology, and Ability. Each of these types when increased with cores add damage bonuses (Ability depending on class either increases damage or duration.) Weapons either are your standard semi-autos or fully automatic bullet based guns or lasers along with flamethrowers or cryo grenade launchers. There even is a sentry you can use as a regular weapon or deploy it for helping to pick off enemies at your side. 

You can upgrade the camp to get more weapon choices at the start of a run to pick besides the starting pistol you get. There are even artifacts to pick which allow you carry more weapons or lower down cooldowns and so on. Throughout the game you can pick up blueprints to upgrade your camp to have access to more equipment to use through runs. There are even huge boss fights which are quite fun and challenging at the start. I only got as far as to the second boss due to how hard this game is. If you love hard fps games with random rogue-lite to them. You will not be disappointed with this game.
